business_summary.text: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited manufactures heat exchangers, cooling coils and HVAC&R solutions, including fin & tube coils, bar & plate, complete HVAC systems, bus AC systems and refrigeration components, from facilities in Neemrana, Rajasthan.

call_points.text: Consolidated revenue grew 119% YoY in Q1FY27, which the CMD called a strong start to FY27.
Consolidated EBITDA margin expanded 418 bps to 19.44% from 15.26%.
New facility utilisation targeted at 50% in FY27 and 80% next year; old facility fully utilised.
Revenue target of ₹2,250-2,850 Cr stated, but the year to achieve it was not specified.
Capex of ₹30-40 Cr planned on the existing facility for line balancing, mainly for data centre geometry.
Data centre contributed about 16% of FY26 revenue; management expects the share to rise but did not quantify.
Raw material and freight cost increases are passed on to customers on a quarterly basis, with a one-quarter lag.
Board approved QIP of up to ₹500 Cr; objective not concluded, broadly for working capital.
Copper and aluminium prices rose sharply in the last two to three weeks, beyond expectations.
Railways bar and plate heat exchanger approved after six-month field trial; company was L1 in three tenders last week.

Revenue target of ₹2,250-2,850 Cr, year not specified.
Capex of ₹30-40 Cr on existing facility for line balancing.
Bus AC revenue target of ₹150 Cr and at least 15% market share.

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Other Industrial Products

operating_notes.text: Data centre contributed about 16% of FY26 revenue.
Export order booking is around ₹120 Cr, including data centre orders; exports were ~₹100 Cr last year and are targeted to nearly double in FY27.
Inventory holding is around two and a half months.
Export revenue rose 177% YoY in Q1FY27, with products reaching customers in 14 countries.
Consolidated revenue mix in Q1FY27 was 79.24% domestic and 20.76% export.
FY26 consolidated operating cash flow was negative ₹113.80 Cr, with inventories at ₹272.91 Cr.

timeline.summary: On 15 May 2026, KRN Heat Exchanger's Q4/FY26 earnings call guided new-facility utilisation at 50% for FY27 and 80% next year, with FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹609.81 Cr (+38.06% YoY) and a board-approved QIP of up to ₹500 Cr.
KRN Heat Exchanger reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹252.32 Cr, up 119% YoY, with PAT of ₹32.90 Cr, up 165%.
